column1: # Planted scan roots for check_no_decode_swallow.sh: the four rules and the pinned site counts.
# Columns, tab-separated, none empty ("-" for none): fixture (a directory beside this
# table), args (gate arguments, "{}" is the fixture path), stream (both, out or err: the
# gate's output the needles are read from), exit (exact), has (strings that must all
# appear), lacks (strings none of which may appear), is (the whole output; "\t" is a
# tab), what (what the case proves). Needles are fixed strings separated by ";;".
# Each root holds a crates/ tree. Four rules: a failure-log site must not return Ok or clear
# a *_ok flag from its own failure arm; a decode step that fails must return Err; the shared
# chunked prefill must run its exit sweep on every outcome; a counted NaN must be raised
# before the token is emitted. The last rule iterates whatever grep finds, so the gate pins the
# number of detector and guard call sites it expects (11 and 17): every root carries a
# nan_floor.rs of planted sites that make up the counts, and a case that varies one site does
# it in nan_site.rs, so a failing case fails for the rule it names and not for the count.
# A root with nothing to scan fails on the counts.
